en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad town square with a decorative streetlamp in the center and several people walking or standing around. Surrounding the square are ivy‑covered and ornate historic buildings, including a town hall and a church or clock tower. The printed red captions on the image identify the location as Albertplatz and note the Rathaus (town hall) in Riesa on the Elbe River.
